metadata.title: Baked Bramley Apples
metadata.description: A guide to cooking baked Bramley apples. Baked apples make a delicious, easy to cook pudding or even a light lunch. The video offers advice on how to cook baked Bramleys, and offers inspiration for fillings. Visit the website at http://www.bramleyapples.co.uk for more recipes and tips.

summary.brief: A woman in a green shirt cores, fills and bakes several Bramley apples with a variety of sweet and savory mixtures.
summary.detailed: The woman greets the viewer and explains that she will make baked Bramley apples. She places a green apple on a wooden cutting board, scores the outer edge and removes the core to create a hollow cavity. She prepares six different fillings: honey mixed with pecans, minced meat with ginger, dates combined with brown sugar and almonds, orange segments tossed with cinnamon and honey, goat cheese blended with char‑grilled peppers, and a bacon‑butter mixture (some apples also contain raisins and orange juice). After chopping a small orange, she moves the ingredients across the board and spoons each mixture into the appropriate apple. The stuffed apples are arranged on a tray and baked in a pre‑heated oven at 180 °C gas mark six for about thirty minutes until the tops turn lightly golden. Once cooked, she tops the apples with a dab of butter and serves them with a sprinkling of icing sugar and a dollop of cream or Greek yogurt. The segment ends with a close‑up of the finished baked apples and a Bramley Apples brand advertisement.

action.detailed: Core and score each apple, spoon the assorted sweet and savory fillings into the cavities, bake them until golden, and finish with a dollop of butter before serving.

She places the green apple on top of it and pushes herself forward a bit to begin the first step of the video. She starts with drilling a hole in the top of the apple and inserts the knife into the hole. We see her hand move the apple back and forth as she pushes the knife in and out. We see her hand move twice as she walks to the left, so the drilling action is done twice. We see her hands move back to the original position to push the apple forward. The apple moves upwards to reveal the hole as she is done drilling. The video then shows the woman reaching out of left frame and grabbing another apple. The woman leans to the right as she pushes and we are done seeing the drilling action. She then reaches to the left and grabs a knife block containing knives. She takes a knife with a black and gray handle and points it vertically up. She moves her hand in a slight backwards motion and we see the blade of the knife come down towards the apple. We see her hand move down to slice through the apple and her hand move upwards and her arm to show the apple as the knife is pressed down. We see her hand move backwards as she pushes the knife again. We see the apple move to the right then down and then the hand pushes the knife back down. The woman's right hand is pulled out of frame and only her arm is shown as she moves it slightly forward. She moves her head backwards slightly as she leans to the left. She then walks forward to grab the bottle of honey. The bottle is grabbed from the right, with her hand moving out of frame. She sets the bottle down on the countertop. She then holds a bowl in her left hand and a spoon in her right and grabs a bowl of pecans from a white bowl that has a brownish color to it. The bowl is tilted slightly to the right to dump out the pecans into the bowl. We see her hand move left and right as she pours the pecans. She then grabs a wooden block in the middle and pushes it down onto the counter to the left. She grabs a white bowl and begins to use a knife to cut a small slice of orange. She moves the knife left and right and we see her hand move in and out of frame. She puts the knife down and picks up the bowl. She tilts it to the left and we can see the orange as the bowl slides off the cutting board. We see her hand move forward then up as she moves the bowl out of the frame.
The video is shot on an open set kitchen counter and area. There is a white and silver microwave, a dark brown wood cabinets that have a silver handle, a tan wood cutting board, a silver knife set, and a stainless steel knife set that are all in view. There is a round white bowl with a silver knife in it, a silver knife set on the cutting board, and a silver bowl in the bottom left of the view. In the top left, a vase filled with pink tulips can be seen. Below that is a white box, a silver knife holder, and a white bowl filled with what looks to be green apples. We also see a stainless steel sink, a silver faucet, a white sponge, and a silver tray. We also see a red bowl, a jar of honey, and a knife, and a bag of pecans all on the counter in the background. There is a wooden cutting board on the counter and a stainless steel kettle to the right of the cutting board. The kitchen has a tan marble surface with speckles of brown, tan, and beige. We see a white wall in the background, a silver switch plate, and silver handles on the dark brown cabinets that are above the counter.
